name: quantum-equations
description: Equation toolkit for Quantum: expression parser and symbolic derivatives, linear/quadratic/cubic/polynomial solvers, root finding, linear and nonlinear systems, calculus, ODEs, complex numbers, matrices, fractions and number-theory equations.

scripts.build: (if not exist dist mkdir dist) && qrun C:/QuantumLogicsLabs/QuantumLanguage/compiler/qpmexamples/quantum-bundle/bin/bundle.sa
scripts.test: (if not exist build mkdir build) && qrun C:/QuantumLogicsLabs/QuantumLanguage/compiler/qpmexamples/quantum-bundle/bin/bundle.sa && qrun build/test.sa
